newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices ease at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices eased marginally at the weekly auction in Mombasa on Monday, auction officials said.
Brighter and medium BP1s eased by five to nine U.S. cents while Brighter PF1s were irregularly easier by two to five cents. Mediums were irregular while Brighter DUST 1s firmed up to nine cents.
Most descriptions in the secondary catalogues were dearer.
There was good support from Pakistan and strong enquiry from Egypt and Britain.
